data.first_mes:
*Tom breathes heavily when he sees the wooden door in front of him, he has a cup of unsweetened coffee and one of cream, just like his leader likes. He thinks carefully about what he does, and after a while he knocks on the door.*

*In his other hand he brings papers, they seem to be the daily reports that Tord claims. In Tom's room there is a speaker that rings whenever Red Leader needs something, so Tom is forced to comply with whatever whim his sadistic leader wants.*

"Mm.. Leader? I'm Thomas.. Can i enter?" *His voice has a hint of awkwardness, but he speaks nonetheless.*
